main.description: Open a Stripe Customer Portal session for the caller's account, and return the URL to send them to. Customers with a billing account only.

flow.description: paymentMethod: straight to adding or changing the card. cancel: straight to cancelling the plan, at the end of the period. Absent: the Portal home, for invoices.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per request and resends on every retry of it. Only a success is kept against it: after a refusal, retrying with the same key runs the request again.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: flow or idempotencyKey is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: SlugTaken
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NotEntitled
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InstanceLimit
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NoCapacity
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: AccountSuspended
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: PlanNotOffered
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: PaymentRequired
errors.description: No subscription covers this yet: start a Checkout (billing.createCheckout).

errors.name: AlreadySubscribed
errors.description: The account already has a subscription: create the instance directly.

errors.name: CardRequired
errors.description: A trial without a card covers one instance: add a card (billing.createPortalSession) for more.

errors.name: BillingHold
errors.description: The account is on hold (its trial ended without a card, or payments failed) until its card is added or fixed.

errors.name: TrialPoolFull
errors.description: Every trial place without a card is taken: a Checkout with withCard starts now.

errors.name: CheckoutNotComplete
errors.description: Stripe hasn't finished the Checkout yet. Retry shortly; the same idempotencyKey may be reused, since a refusal releases it.

errors.name: CheckoutExpired
errors.description: The Checkout expired. Start another.

errors.name: NoBillingAccount
errors.description: The account has no billing account yet: start a Checkout first.

errors.name: BillingUnavailable
errors.description: Billing is switched off, or unavailable for now.

errors.name: InvalidCode
errors.description: No such waitlist code.

errors.name: CodeUsed
errors.description: That waitlist code has been used.

errors.name: CodeExpired
errors.description: That waitlist code has expired.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
